original_test_intent: Independently validate the change-default workflow for Processor Configuration: approved processor controls must accept a non-default project change, persist across reboot, and return to the authoritative project/SPEC defaults without losing CPU/socket/core/thread/NUMA visibility or boot stability.
original_method: Bind this change-default variant to motherboard, CPU/socket population, BIOS/microcode and a revision-controlled project default oracle; preserve existing logs; choose an approved reversible change-control matrix rather than all/random values; use KVM to record baseline, apply one value or dependency group, save/reboot and verify retained page plus effective CPU topology; invoke the approved Load Defaults step and verify whether it restores project or factory values; preserve POST/boot/SEL/kernel evidence and stop at first topology or boot fault with owner-controlled recovery.

Authoritative project and factory default distinction plus approved reversible non-default values and dependencies
CPU/socket/core/thread/NUMA and POST/boot/error acceptance for each phase
Maintenance/KVM, last-known-good settings, physical/CMOS recovery ownership and escalation
